module: GE extension `core_multiSpawn`: generation and placement of vehicle groups. It can build a random group from the installed vehicles (with population weights, filters, country, year), spawn it in a formation (road ahead/behind, race grid, traffic, lines), or teleport existing vehicles into a new formation. Spawning is done via a job, one vehicle per frame, and only one group at a time (subsequent ones are queued). Used notably by the UI traffic app and by gameplay code (onVehicleGroupSpawned is listened to by 5 modules).
usage:
-- 10 random vehicles (cars and trucks) in front of the player
local group = core_multiSpawn.createGroup(10, {filters = {Type = {car = 1, truck = 0.4}}})
core_multiSpawn.spawnGroup(group, 10, {name = 'myGroup', mode = 'roadAhead', gap = 20})
-- later: delete this group
core_multiSpawn.deleteVehicles(nil, 'myGroup')
notes: A group is an array of entries { model, config, paint, paint2, paint3, paintName, paintName2, paintName3, ... }. The old array format { model, config, paint, paint2, paint3 } is also accepted by setVehicleSpawnData. A nil or 'base' config becomes the model's default config. paintName '(Random)' requests random paints.

Formation modes (options.mode): roadAhead (default), roadBehind, roadAheadAlt, roadBehindAlt, traffic, raceGrid, raceGridAlt, lineLeft, lineRight, lineBehind, lineAhead, lineAbove; 'road' is an alias of roadAhead. An unknown mode falls back to lineAhead. Road modes use the navigation map (map); if no road is found the fallback is lineAhead.

Position options: pos (vec3) and dir (vec3) or rot (quat); otherwise the player vehicle (OOBB, slot 0 reserved for the player: numbering starts at 1), otherwise the camera. gap = spacing in meters (15 by default). startIndex shifts the first slot. func(funcData) allows a custom placement function returning pos, dir. customTransforms = imposed array of {pos, rot} (must have at least as many elements as vehicles).
The first vehicle is always created; the following ones are refused (the group stops with a warning) if canSpawnAnotherVehicle() is false, unless options.canSpawnAnotherVehicleCheck == false.

Each created vehicle receives the dynamic field 'vehicleGroup' = options.name (read by deleteVehicles) and possibly 'spawnMeta'. Hook onVehicleGroupSpawned(vehIds, groupId, name) at the end; onVehicleGroupRespawned(vehIds) at the end of a placeGroup.

Population: a config without a Population field gets 10000 if the model or the config is a mod, 0 if both are official. The weight of a model/config is (popBase*popFactor)^popPower; models from countries other than `country` are penalized (0.25/number of models of the country). After each draw, the weight is multiplied by popDecreaseFactor (0.05 by default) to avoid repetitions. modelPopPower/configPopPower <= 0 or nil: uniform draw; popPower capped at 2. Filters: {Type = {car = 1, truck = 0.4, other = 0.1}}; a field absent from the filter gives factor 0 unless the key `other` exists. maxYear (<= 0 = current year) excludes newer configs and penalizes older ones.

Probable bug in buildGroup: `if not modelPopPower then ... else modelIdx = getIndexRandomPop(...)` tests nil whereas the earlier sort also tests `<= 0`. With modelPopPower = 0, shuffledList is filled but ignored, and the draw is done via getIndexRandomPop on weights computed with popPower = 1 (inferred from code).

Probable bug in spawnGroup: spawningBusy is set to true before spawnProcessedGroup is called. If the latter exits early (no MissionGroup, empty data), spawningBusy stays true, and all following groups stay in the queue indefinitely.

onSpawnCCallback: while a group is spawning (spawningBusy), vehicles receive spawnWithEngineRunning = M.startEngines. This flag therefore also applies to any vehicle created during that time by other code.
setupVehicles is deprecated (warning log): use spawnGroup. teleportGroup is an alias of placeGroup.

startEngines.desc: true by default: vehicles of a group spawn with the engine started (via onSpawnCCallback).

useFullData.desc: false by default. If true, createGroup adds modelPop and configPop to each entry of the group.

getInstalledVehicleData.desc: Walks through the installed models and configs (core_vehicles) and builds the base table used to draw a group: per model { model, country, popBase, popFactor, configData = [{ config, popBase, popFactor }] }, plus countryCounts. By default only official content is taken (allMods = false).

params.desc: { allMods, allConfigs, filters, minPop, maxYear, country }. filters defaults to { Type = { car = 1, truck = 1 } }. Note: if params is provided without allConfigs, only the default config of each model is kept.

returns.desc: List of models with a countryCounts field.

createGroup.desc: Creates a random group of `amount` vehicles (10 by default) from the installed vehicles, according to the filters and populations.

params.desc: { allMods, allConfigs, filters, country, modelPopPower, configPopPower, popDecreaseFactor, minPop, maxYear }.

returns.desc: Entries { model, config }; {} if no vehicle matches.

vehIdsToGroup.desc: Converts existing vehicles into group entries (model, config, paints; paint names are '(Custom)').

spawnedVehsToGroup.desc: Converts all vehicles currently in the scene (getAllVehiclesByType) into a group, with optional exclusions.

createSpawnPositions.desc: Computes `amount` formation positions/rotations according to options.mode (see notes), starting from the player, the camera or options.pos.

options.desc: { mode, gap, pos, dir, rot, startIndex, func }.

setVehicleSpawnData.desc: Prepares the spawn data from a group: copies, adjusts to the requested size (fitGroup), fills in the default config, resolves paints (including random ones). A model that is not found is replaced by the default 'pickup' model (error logged).

amount.desc: Requested size; nil keeps the group's size.

returns.desc: Spawn data, nil if the group is empty.

fitGroup.desc: Adjusts a group to `amount` elements, in place: duplicates entries in a loop if it is too small, truncates if it is too large.

spawnGroup.desc: Spawns a vehicle group in formation. If a group is already in progress, the request is queued. Empty group: creates a default one; amount <= 0: does nothing.

options.desc: { name ('custom'), mode ('roadAhead'), gap (15), shuffle, randomPaints, cling, ignoreAdjust, canSpawnAnotherVehicleCheck, pos, dir, rot, startIndex, func, customTransforms }.

returns.desc: Unique group identifier (nil if queued, refused, or scene without MissionGroup).

spawnProcessedGroup.desc: Low-level step of spawnGroup: assigns positions and rotations to the spawn data already prepared by setVehicleSpawnData, sanitizes them (sanitizeVehicleSpawnOptions) and starts the creation job (one vehicle per frame).

spawnOptions.desc: Same options as spawnGroup (name, mode, gap, cling, ...).

returns.desc: New group identifier, nil if no MissionGroup or empty data.

placeGroup.desc: Teleports existing vehicles into a new formation (one per 0.02 s interval via a job, or immediately if options.instant). Positions are corrected by the reference node offset unless ignoreAdjust; safeTeleport is used unless ignoreSafe.

vehIds.desc: Ids of the vehicles to place.

options.desc: { mode, gap, pos, dir, rot, startIndex, func, customTransforms, instant, ignoreAdjust, ignoreSafe }.

setupVehicles.desc: Deprecated: creates a random group then spawns it. Use spawnGroup.

deleteVehicles.desc: Deletes vehicles created via this module (those with the vehicleGroup field), starting from the end of the list, with optional limit and group name. Used by the traffic app.

amount.desc: Max number to delete; nil = all.

groupName.desc: Only deletes this group; nil = any group.

onSpawnCCallback.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is created on the C++ side: during a group spawn, asks the vehicle to spawn with the engine running (according to startEngines).
